history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration strengthen oversight on utilization of websites/ applications to improve their efficiency and effectiveness.
history.administration_response: The Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) requests that this recommendation be closed. The ESCAP senior management team was briefed on the usage analytics and compliance status of ESCAP websites and applications. The Commission then initiated the annual self-assessment of websites and web applications in the Unite Apps portals of the Office of Information and Communications Technology, updated outdated/missing information, began to brief the business owners on their division’s website landscape and made recommendations for consolidating websites and improving compliance. ESCAP has also instituted biannual reporting on website compliance to the ESCAP committee on information technology security. In 2025, the Commission completed the annual self- assessment of websites and applications in Unite Apps in coordination with the business focal points and increased to 100 per cent the rate of compliance with reporting requirements.
history.board_assessment: Given that ESCAP has initiated an annual self- assessment of websites and applications, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
